about: Demo state per verification screen: what to set so the player shows the values of the Figma design. how: "vlcrc" = write option=value into the portable profile's vlcrc while the player is closed (VLC rewrites the file on exit); VLC finds options by name and skips [section] lines when it loads (src/config/file.c:190), "section" is the [module] VLC itself writes it under; booleans 0/1, colours decimal, floats with 6 decimals, an empty value means unset. "ui" = per-media / per-session state set in the running player (uia = the UI Automation name / role from the QML Accessible.name). "default" = a fresh profile already shows the Figma value. "mask" = cannot be set (or should not be): leave out of the pixel diff; "bounds" (Figma units, relative to the spec frame) is given where Figma has no text to mask by; "alt" is a way to set it anyway. "qml_differs" = the build shows another text or control whatever the state: a real difference, not a demo-state problem. "side_effect": apply that vlcrc state for its screen only. "below_fold": under the sidebar footer, visible only after scrolling. src = file:line in this repo.
notes: Per-screen vlcrc states conflict, so each screen needs its own vlcrc: sub-language (sidebar-subtitles "English" / settings-subtitles masked), freetype-font ("Inter" / empty), freetype-color (12105912 / default), freetype-outline-color (789516 / default).
audio-track=0 and sub-track=0 are wanted by both sidebar-audio / sidebar-subtitles and settings-playback (consistent).
sub-track=0 and sub-language=English turn subtitles on at every file open; make_media.py keeps them off so no subtitle text covers the bars: do not use these states for the player screens.
tracks-subtitles / tracks-audio / tracks-video and sidebar-video / sidebar-audio need "Verify Tracks.mkv" playing (track list, Stereo Mode, Zoom).
